apple.name: Kizuki: Learn Japanese & JLPT
apple.subtitle: Video Listening & Vocabulary
apple.promotionalText: Learn Japanese from real video clips: tap any word, see the grammar explained, and remember it with the original voice. Made for JLPT N5–N3 listening.
apple.description:
Finally understand real Japanese.

Kizuki turns short clips from real Japanese videos into listening practice you can actually follow. Tap any word, see why it's said that way, and remember it with the voice you heard.

Kizuki (気づき) means "the moment it clicks."

HOW IT WORKS
• Watch: short clips of real Japanese, from street interviews, everyday conversations, vlogs and comedy to drama, anime scenes and easy-Japanese teachers. Each clip lasts a few seconds to half a minute.
• Tap: the transcript follows the audio line by line, with furigana and romaji when you want them. Tap a word for its reading, its meaning in this sentence and its JLPT level.
• Understand: every line has a short plain-English note on the grammar and nuance. Still unsure? Ask Kizuki, the built-in AI tutor.
• Remember: saved words become flashcards that replay the exact moment you heard them. Spaced repetition brings each word back right before you'd forget it.

WHAT YOU GET
• 2,500+ clips from nearly 1,000 videos and 500+ channels
• Clips tagged by JLPT level, N5 to N1 (most are N5–N3)
• A feed matched to your level and interests
• Search any word or grammar pattern and hear it in other clips
• Hiragana and katakana decks for complete beginners
• A vocabulary count that grows as words move from new to known
• Daily minutes, streaks and achievements to keep the habit going

MADE FOR
• Beginners who want real listening from the start
• JLPT N5–N3 learners who need more listening practice
• Anime and J-drama fans who want to rely less on subtitles
• Anyone getting ready for a trip to Japan

KIZUKI PREMIUM
A Kizuki Premium subscription is required to watch clips, review flashcards and ask the AI tutor. Choose a yearly or monthly plan. The yearly plan can include a free trial; the trial length and the price in your currency are shown before you subscribe.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase, or when a free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID account settings.

Videos play in YouTube's official player. All clips belong to their creators and channels; Kizuki is not affiliated with YouTube.

play.title: Kizuki: Learn Japanese & JLPT
play.shortDescription: Learn Japanese by immersion: real videos, tap any word, JLPT vocab & flashcards
play.fullDescription:
Learn Japanese from real videos, and finally understand what you hear.

Kizuki is a Japanese immersion app: short clips from real Japanese videos become listening practice you can follow. Tap any word, see the grammar explained in plain English, and keep new Japanese vocabulary as flashcards with the original voice.

Kizuki (気づき) means "the moment it clicks."

★ REAL JAPANESE LISTENING
Swipe through 2,500+ short clips from nearly 1,000 videos and 500+ channels: street interviews, everyday conversations, vlogs, comedy, drama, anime scenes, news and easy-Japanese teachers. Hear natural speed, casual speech, useful phrases and real pronunciation, a few seconds at a time.

★ TAP ANY WORD
An interactive transcript follows the audio line by line. Turn on furigana for kanji readings, or romaji while you are still learning hiragana and katakana. Tap a word to see its reading, its meaning in this sentence, dictionary senses and its JLPT level, without leaving the video.

★ GRAMMAR NOTES AND AN AI TUTOR
Every line has a short note on the grammar and nuance. Have a question? Ask Kizuki, the built-in AI Japanese tutor, about anything you just heard.

★ FLASHCARDS WITH THE ORIGINAL VOICE
Save Japanese words as you watch. Your spaced-repetition (SRS) flashcards replay the clip where you heard each word, so you remember the voice and the scene, not just a translation.

★ JLPT N5, N4 AND N3 PRACTICE
Every clip is tagged by JLPT level, from N5 to N1 (most clips are N5–N3). Kizuki builds a feed for your level and interests, so beginners get easy Japanese and intermediate learners get real speed. Search any word or grammar pattern to hear it in other clips.

★ WHY REAL VIDEOS WORK
Textbook Japanese is slow and polite. Real Japanese is fast, casual and full of words that drills never teach. Short clips you can replay let you hear the same Japanese words in many real situations until they click. That is how Japanese listening comprehension grows: learn nihongo the way people actually speak it, with language immersion that fits into a few minutes a day.

★ START FROM ZERO
New to Japanese? Learn the Japanese alphabet, hiragana and katakana, with their own decks, then start watching with romaji and furigana turned on.

★ WATCH YOUR VOCABULARY GROW
Words move from new to known as you review. See your Japanese vocabulary grow, set your daily minutes, keep a streak and unlock achievements.

GREAT FOR
• Beginners who want to learn Japanese with real listening from day one
• JLPT N5, N4 and N3 students who need listening practice
• Anime and J-drama fans who want to rely less on subtitles
• Travellers getting ready for Japan
• Anyone who wants to study Japanese for a few minutes a day
• Learners who stalled with textbook and drill apps

SUBSCRIPTION
A Kizuki Premium subscription is required to watch clips, review flashcards and ask the AI tutor. Choose yearly or monthly; the yearly plan can include a free trial. The trial length and the price in your currency are shown before you subscribe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before renewal; manage or cancel any time in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions.

Videos play in YouTube's official player. All clips belong to their creators and channels; Kizuki is not affiliated with YouTube.
